problems: rule lists vowel letters, not sounds; misleads on 'an hour', 'a uniform'

fix.rule: Put a or an before one thing: an before a vowel sound (an apple, an hour), a before others.

problems: false 'always': not every sentence needs am/is/are (I like cats); invites 'I am like cats'

fix.rule: In a present sentence with no other verb, use am, is or are: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are.

problems: interleaving item ambiguous: 'on the box' is also correct

fix.interleaving_item: Write in or on: The book is ___ the table. -> answer: on

problems: 'the noun after a number takes -s' is false for one (one duck)
interleaving item uses 'fish' (no -s), clashing with the rule

fix.rule: Say there is for one thing; say there are for two or more, with -s on the noun.
fix.interleaving_item: Write some or any: Are there ___ frogs in the pond? -> answer: any

problems: rule does not cover place/time at the end (part of outcome)
adjective-before-noun is outside the outcome; worked example and usual error drift to it

fix.rule: Put the doer first, then the action, then the thing; put place or time at the end.
fix.usual_error: the verb before the subject, or place/time in the middle
fix.worked_examples: [subject first] The monkey eats a banana. | [place/time at the end] The farmer feeds the cows in the morning.

problems: wrong sentence does not show the named error (joining with and)

fix.usual_error: no capital at the start, small i, or no full stop

problems: interleaving answer 'an' is not one of the given choices (a or some)

fix.interleaving_item: Write a or some: The horse wants ___ carrot. -> answer: a

problems: word set has eat, drink (verbs) and duplicate bananas; not foods/drinks
'liquids' too hard for A1; 'spoon food' unclear

fix.rule: We eat food, and we eat soup too; we drink water, juice and milk.
fix.word_set: bread, rice, apple, milk, egg, fish, soup, water, juice, tea, cheese, chicken, banana

problems: rule says keep p not b, then gives 'bag' (a b word) as example; no v word in set

fix.rule: Classroom things have short English names; keep p (not b) in words like pen and pencil.
fix.usual_error: b for p, or an Arabic phrase word for word

problems: garden is not a room in a home

fix.word_set: kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, living room, garage, hall, dining room

problems: wrong 'sefen' shows f for v, not the named error v for f

fix.usual_error: f and v mixed up in a number (fivteen, sefen), or clock for hour

problems: wrong 'little big' is odd and does not show the named error (wrong partner of a pair)

fix.right: The bike is old, but the car is new.
fix.wrong: The bike is old, but the car is young.

problems: kind, funny, friendly are personality words, not hair/eyes/height
clue 'not fat' is body-sensitive for children and also fits 'slim'

fix.word_set: hair, eyes, nose, big, red, tall, short, long, curly, straight, thin, black, brown, blue, green, grey
